I'll start with the good news! We've proved our potential. Lightkeeper is pleased with us, and wants to meet you in person... Yes, you specifically. The bad news is you can't get to him that easily, the place is rigged with land mines. Plus, a sniper shoots everyone who comes near the lighthouse. We must somehow let them know that it's you, among all the other PMCs that are sniffing around there. So we'll put together a transponder for you. He will pick up the signal, give a sign to the sniper, and disable the mines. The path will be safe. I've already written down what materials I need to assemble it. Finding the transmitter box won't be easy, but I think you could try looking somewhere where the USECs settled down.}} ==Requirements== * Unlocks 24 hours after completion of [[Assessment - Part 3]] ==Objectives== * Find 2 [[Piece of plexiglass|Pieces of plexiglass]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Find 1 [[Insulating tape]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Find 2 [[Military circuit board|Military circuit boards]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Find 1 [[Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Find 1 [[Working LCD]] [[Found in raid|in raid]] * Obtain 1 [[Radio transmitter body]] on [[Lighthouse]] * Hand over 2 [[Piece of plexiglass|Pieces of plexiglass]] to [[Mechanic]] * Hand over 1 [[Insulating tape]] to [[Mechanic]] * Hand over 2 [[Military circuit board|Military circuit boards]] to [[Mechanic]] * Hand over 1 [[Military COFDM Wireless Signal Transmitter]] to [[Mechanic]] * Hand over 1 [[Working LCD]] to [[Mechanic]] * Hand over 1 [[Radio transmitter body]] to [[Mechanic]] ==Rewards== * +30,500 [[EXP]] *[[Mechanic]] Rep '''+0.01''' {{quote|Alright, we have everything we need, that's good.}} ==Guide== {|class="wikitable" !
